credits.title: 💰 Your Credit Balance
credits.content: You start with 20 credits. Use them to access AI-powered features like resume optimization, job matching, and interview prep. Credits refresh monthly!

upload.title: 📄 Upload Your Resume
upload.content: Start by uploading your resume (PDF or DOCX). Our AI will analyze it and help you tailor it for the role you choose.

features.title: ✨ Powerful AI Features
features.content: Explore job matching, resume optimization, interview preparation, and more. Each feature costs a few credits and delivers professional results.

referral.title: 🎁 Earn More Credits
referral.content: Share your referral link with friends! When they sign up, you both get 5 free credits. It's a win-win!

intro.title: Vision 2030 Alignment
intro.content: This AI-powered feature analyzes how your resume aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 priorities. It costs 2 credits and provides detailed insights.

calculate.title: 🎯 Get Your Alignment Score
calculate.content: Click 'Calculate Alignment' to analyze your resume against Vision 2030 goals. You'll get a score and detailed recommendations.

methodology.title: 📊 How It's Calculated
methodology.content: Want to understand the methodology? Click 'How is this calculated?' to see the detailed scoring criteria based on official Vision 2030 pillars.
